purpose: Execute the atomic extrude-profile-to-face operation within the MA-07 boundary: One root-part target-face extrusion through the V21 ExtrudeFaces.UpTo command. It does not construct a profile, discover faces, attach a transient body, save, or infer source-sheet consumption from command return order.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires extrude-profile-to-face and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: profile_face
inputs.description: A current planar face that is the only face of an open root-part sheet body. Profile construction and semantic face discovery are caller-owned.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Finite nonzero extrusion direction; normalized by the shared direction helper.

inputs.name: target_face
inputs.description: A distinct current face selected as the native UpTo target.

inputs.name: seed_point_mm
inputs.description: Finite seed point in millimetres passed to ExtrudeFaces.UpTo.

inputs.name: section_policy
inputs.description: How the caller wants source-face lifecycle checked. kernel-managed records counts without guessing kernel behavior; preserve and consume assert the requested result. Default: "kernel-managed".

preconditions: profile_face is current, planar, and the only face of one open root sheet body.
target_face is a distinct current root face.
direction and seed_point_mm are finite and direction is nonzero.
section_policy is kernel-managed, preserve, or consume.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {body: current root DesignBody, section_policy: string, source_count_before: integer, source_count_after: integer}; body is the unique newly detected closed positive-volume solid.

postconditions: ExtrudeFaces.UpTo is called with FaceSelection objects, a normalized direction, the supplied seed point, and ExtrudeType.ForceIndependent.
After re-enumerating current root bodies, exactly one new closed positive-volume body is detected after sheet owners are excluded.
kernel-managed reports source_count_before and source_count_after without asserting either lifecycle; preserve requires the source face count to remain one and consume requires it to become zero.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Root bodies are enumerated before and after the mutating command; topology references must be reacquired after success.

failure_modes.detection: ExtrudeFaces.UpTo reports failure, raises, or no unique new closed positive-volume body is found.

failure_modes.detection: The requested preserve/consume policy does not match the post-command source-face count.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate current root faces and supply a valid one-face planar source, reachable target, and finite parameters; no command mutation is expected.
Treat the root document as potentially partially mutated, inspect/reopen a clean run-owned copy, and rerun only after source/target reachability is diagnosed; no rollback is implemented.
Stop and record the kernel lifecycle; use kernel-managed for an explicitly unasserted variant or rerun from a clean copy with a supported policy.
